svg.title: GhostCred. A scan finds a live secret in an agent config file, maps where it spread across logs and git history, then revokes it at GitHub, OpenAI and Anthropic.

g.text: Leak detector and auto-revoker for AI toolchains
Finds leaked secrets where AI coding agents
leave them, then revokes them at the provider.
Scans the blind spots· agent configs, history
Maps the blast radius· logs, CI, git
Acts, not just alerts· revokes at the source
